mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the quarters where GDPC1 increased consecutively.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a supply shock, which can lead to increased costs and reduced output, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the combination signals an inflationary environment with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in housing starts over two consecutive months signals a strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the months where HOUST increased consecutively.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures rise by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of the instances where both conditions are met.
